Bundles [MPTUNNEL 0.6.7](https://github.com/mnihyc/mptunnel/releases/tag/v0.6.7).

- UDP destination errors remain isolated to the affected association, preventing unrelated TCP carriers from disconnecting during DNS traffic. DNS burst admission and datagram close handoff are bounded.
- The embedded dashboard improves latency reporting, separates directional traffic and speed, groups used paths, and supports sortable columns. Refreshes and filtering preserve Quality measurements and stable sorting without hiding real stale data or resets.
- Response writers reuse valid negative recovery results to reduce repeated discovery. CPU benefits depend on the workload; mixed-path startup, high concurrency and loss still have known performance limits. See the core release notes for measured tradeoffs.

MPP wire version remains **16**. Use a MPTUNNEL 0.6.7 server to receive all fixes; 0.6.0–0.6.6 servers remain wire-compatible. Servers using 0.5.x require a coordinated app/server upgrade. Existing profiles, application IDs and the signing identity are preserved.

Downloads include signed F-Droid APKs for `arm64-v8a`, `x86_64`, and a universal APK containing both. `SHA256SUMS` verifies downloads; `build-provenance.json` identifies the app source, exact MPTUNNEL release, native archive digests and APKs.
